draft.subject: Quick hand with your Wrenfield setup
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for your patience on the Slack integration 
tickets 
- and I see your note about the notification bell badge count is still open with our team; they're on it.

In the meantime, I'd like to help you get the foundation in place. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is usually the best starting point. A teammate can also be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you.

Best,
Priya
